newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 19.

text.p: -- Hewlett-Packard Co posted fourth quarter earnings slightly below expectations after the market close on Monday. Profits fell 4.0 percent from a year earlier, to $0.62 a share, on lower-than-expected revenues. The company said it expects its margins to remain under pressure.
Hewlett-Packard shares closed at 50-1/8, off 3/4, before the release of the earnings.

-- Shares of newly-floated German telecommunications company Deutsche Telekom fell more than five percent in Germany on Tuesday as many investors took profits. The shares fell 1.80 marks to 32.10. They were priced at 28.50 marks for yesterday's IPO.
The shares closed at 21-1/2 on the New York Stock Exchange.
